# Pinned GenieX C header

`geniex.h` is the unchanged C ABI header from Qualcomm GenieX commit
`071f609995470bdb0e0769ab964754adfaab7e47`. Its SHA256 is
`c5d441ee290c5ec83f01ec1af9a7c16cdd8c740b522b78c23ed667062fc21e40`.

The exact official `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` from that same commit are retained as
`GENIEX-LICENSE` and `GENIEX-UPSTREAM-NOTICE.md`. Their upstream Git blob IDs are
`74eadadcbcbd7754420fde09f261326df8cf2697` and
`41cbbc8ffb15baaeb8f93b085d1f62de7497cdf4`, respectively.

Sources:

- https://github.com/qualcomm/GenieX/blob/071f609995470bdb0e0769ab964754adfaab7e47/LICENSE
- https://github.com/qualcomm/GenieX/blob/071f609995470bdb0e0769ab964754adfaab7e47/NOTICE
- https://github.com/qualcomm/GenieX/blob/071f609995470bdb0e0769ab964754adfaab7e47/sdk/include/geniex.h

The upstream notice describes the broader GenieX distribution; it is retained
as upstream attribution and is not a list of Java or network dependencies added
to this framework-only Android application. Native SDK libraries and model
weights must be obtained separately under their applicable terms. They are not
part of this source publication.
